prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Layout changes to path selection stages significantly improved conversion.
Interactive walkthrough redesigns, new adoption flows, and sign-in reassurance hints significantly hurt conversion.
Copy changes, step reordering, wait-time info, photo upload guidance, and other layout changes showed no clear effect.
Predictions were too low for path selection stage layout changes.
Predictions were too high for interactive walkthrough redesigns, new adoption flows, sign-in hints, step reordering, copy changes, and wait-time info.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, layout: -0.0% over 1 test(s)
- adoption, new_flow: -15.6% over 1 test(s)
- adoption, redesign: +0.2% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, copy: -0.3% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, layout: +6.3% over 2 test(s)
- choose_path, redesign: +0.5% over 2 test(s)
- finish, copy: +0.4% over 2 test(s)
- finish, redesign: -8.7% over 3 test(s)
- home, redesign: -0.3% over 2 test(s)
- home, wait_info: -1.2% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, hint: -5.4% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, layout: -1.0% over 3 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: -0.1% over 1 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 80.5%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 18.8%

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Pick Friend Choice Cards Layout Redesign: Redesign the friend selection screen layout to choice cards layout to present pet choices clearly. (why: Adoption has the lowest step conversion at 60.9%, and choice card layout changes significantly boosted conversion in previous selection stages.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Pet Controls Intro New Screen: Add a dedicated screen right before finish introducing desktop interaction basics like right-clicking to manage and dragging to move the pet. (why: Support receives frequent complaints from users who are confused about how to control, hide, or talk to their pet post-setup.)
2: [adoption, redesign] Adoption Certificate Stage Layout Redesign: Rebuild the adoption certificate screen using a stage layout to streamline completion. (why: Stage layout upgrades previously produced significant conversion improvements on early onboarding steps.)
3: [sign_in, reorder] Post Selection Sign In Reorder: Move sign-in to occur right after customization and pet selection, immediately before generation begins. (why: Sign-in currently happens before pet creation engagement; delaying sign-in until after friend selection increases user commitment before asking for auth.)
4: [home, redesign] Waiting Room Full Bleed Layout Redesign: Redesign the waiting room to a full bleed layout with an explicit progress indicator while pet generation finishes. (why: The home stage has a high median wait time of 201s (mean 2336s), leading to user fatigue during asset creation.)
5: [sign_in, hint] Sign In Account Data Save Hint: Add a clear hint under sign-in stating that using your main account preserves your pets across sessions. (why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or reset after signing in again on duplicate or secondary accounts.)
6: [finish, copy] Home Intro Desktop Controls Headline Copy: Update the home intro text to give explicit instructions on where to look for the spawned pet and how to right-click for controls. (why: Multiple support emails reported that pets did not appear visible on desktop or users were confused how to interact with them.)
7: [home, notification] Waiting Screen Background Notification: Enable desktop notification opt-in on the waiting screen so users know they can safely minimize the window while waiting. (why: Home wait step median duration is 201 seconds, making background notification critical to avoid user abandon.)
8: [choose_path, incentive] Story Mascot Welcome Component: Add a playful mascot welcoming element to the initial story screen. (why: Path selection and story screen visual enhancements have consistently yielded high early funnel conversion.)
9: [adoption, redesign] Photo Upload Card Layout Redesign: Redesign the photo upload step to use structured card layout containers for upload options. (why: Adoption stage experiences major drop-off (60.9% step conversion); visual card layout updates have proved effective elsewhere.)
